title: Syngas-to-methanol reference family
reaction: CO + 2 H2 -> CH3OH (with CO2 + 3 H2 -> CH3OH + H2O)
objective: Optional literature-backed reference family for sanity-checking catalyst economics for industrial methanol synthesis from CO/CO2/H2 syngas, distinct from the pure-CO2 feed family. COMET itself remains reaction-agnostic and this family is a screening aid, not a process design.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance economics, source confidence, route confidence, and performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward selling cost while keeping route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward transparent, higher-confidence pricing and more reproducible routes.

citations.label: Applied Catalysis 1988
citations.note: The ICI industrial-practice review consolidating methanol-synthesis kinetics and mechanism over Cu/ZnO/Al2O3.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2008
citations.note: Coprecipitation pH/temperature-to-activity map for Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 under commercial-like CO/CO2/H2 testing.

citations.label: Science 2012
citations.note: The active site of the industrial catalyst: Zn-decorated Cu steps with bulk defects.

citations.label: Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 2016
citations.note: Process and technology review of industrial methanol synthesis.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2019
citations.note: Industrial catalyst-development directions for methanol synthesis.

citations.label: Handbook of Heterogeneous Catalysis 2008
citations.note: Hansen and Hojlund Nielsen's methanol-synthesis chapter, the standard industrial reference.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2012
citations.note: Hydrotalcite-derived Pd2Ga and PdZn intermetallic methanol-synthesis catalysts.

citations.label: J. Catal. 2016
citations.note: 1-5 wt% Pd/ZnO: PdZn alloy suppresses reverse water-gas shift, 60% methanol selectivity at 250 C and 20 bar.

citations.label: Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2021
citations.note: PdZn/ZnO mechanism: ZnO activates CO2 while the alloy supplies hydrogen; 443 g MeOH per kg catalyst per hour at 260 C and 50 bar.

citations.label: Appl. Catal. A 1996
citations.note: Multicomponent Cu/ZnO promoter classification (Ga2O3, Al2O3, ZrO2, Cr2O3) with long-term stability; best catalyst ~51 wt% Cu, 22 wt% Zn.

citations.label: Appl. Catal. B 2001
citations.note: Ga-promoted Cu on ZnO: highly effective methanol catalyst with strong support/promoter dependence.

citations.label: Science 2016
citations.note: Quantified Zn-coverage promotion of Cu: methanol activity rises ~3x from 0.04 to 0.47 Zn coverage.

route_templates.name: Controlled-pH co-precipitation with pelletizing
preprocess: Sodium-carbonate precipitant dosing at controlled pH and temperature
postprocess: Slow reduction in dilute hydrogen (in situ or pre-reduced)
quality_gates: Precipitation pH/temperature log within the Baltes activity window
Crush strength and methanol activity spot test
route_templates.route_note: The documented industrial chain: precipitation pH and temperature are the activity-controlling variables, and activation is a slow reduction in ~2-3 vol% H2.

route_templates.name: Pd on ZnO with high-temperature alloying
preprocess: Chloride-managed Pd precursor or PVA-stabilized Pd colloid preparation
synthesis: Sol-immobilisation or incipient-wetness deposition of Pd onto ZnO
postprocess: High-temperature reduction (~400 C) forming the PdZn alloy
route_templates.route_note: The selectivity-giving PdZn alloy forms only on high-temperature pre-reduction; chloride residues must be avoided, favoring the sol route.

route_templates.name: Ga/Zr-promoted co-precipitation
preprocess: Cu/Zn nitrate solution make-up with Ga or Zr promoter nitrate
route_templates.route_note: Same chain as the baseline with the promoter salt added at precipitation; promoters split into dispersion-raising and specific-activity-raising classes per the cited study.

candidates.title: Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 (industrial workhorse)
candidates.summary: The co-precipitated 60/30/10-class CuO/ZnO/Al2O3 catalyst behind essentially all commercial methanol, run at 240-260 C and 50-100 bar with Zn-decorated Cu steps as the active site.
decision_notes: The reference economics of the family: cheap metals, the deepest industrial record in this database, and manufacturing quality riding on precipitation control.
Composition screened at the 60/30/10 CuO/ZnO/Al2O3 class figure quoted in the open-access review; Saito's best coprecipitate (51 wt% Cu, 22 wt% Zn metal basis) is consistent.

pricing.note: Contained-copper basis of a ~60 wt% CuO loading with a mild precursor conversion markup.
USGS MCS 2026 North American SHG zinc, 2025e $1.49/lb, x 0.803 Zn mass fraction of ZnO = $1.20/lb contained-metal floor; oxide conversion cost not included.
2025 USGS alumina import value used as the structural-promoter term.

candidates.title: Pd/ZnO intermetallic alternative
candidates.summary: 1-5 wt% Pd alloyed into PdZn on zinc oxide suppresses reverse water-gas shift, delivering up to 443 g methanol per kg catalyst per hour at 260 C and 50 bar in CO2-rich feeds.
decision_notes: Screen it to bound what RWGS suppression is worth: palladium restricts the route to niche duty against the copper baseline.
Performance evidence is from CO2-rich feeds; it supports the archetype but is not a pure-CO syngas benchmark.

pricing.note: Live Pd feed with a markup for the chloride-managed colloid route; 1-5 wt% loadings are source-quoted.
USGS MCS 2026 North American SHG zinc, 2025e $1.49/lb, x 0.803 Zn mass fraction of ZnO = $1.20/lb contained-metal floor.

candidates.title: Ga-promoted Cu/ZnO (Zn-coverage engineering)
candidates.summary: Gallium (or zirconium) promotion of the copper-zinc system tunes Zn coverage on Cu - the lever Science 2016 quantified at ~3x activity - for a modest promoter cost on top of the industrial chain.
decision_notes: The incremental-upgrade play: same plant chain as the baseline, activity and stability bought with a few percent of promoter oxide.
Gallium is the expensive promoter choice; the same route carries ZrO2 promotion at commodity cost if the Ga term dominates the screen.

pricing.note: Contained-copper basis with a mild precursor conversion markup.
USGS MCS 2026 zinc-derived contained-metal floor for the ZnO term.
USGS 2025 refined gallium import value $580/kg = $263.1/lb x 0.744 Ga mass fraction of Ga2O3 = $195.7/lb contained-metal floor; oxide conversion cost not included.
2025 USGS alumina import value used as the balance-of-formulation oxide term.
